subject: The 60-second voice note she loves
preview_text: A tiny trick that makes her feel closer to you instantly. Try it now.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when you want to say something but typing feels too slow? Or worse, you overthink and delete it. She hates that too—but there's a fix that takes exactly 60 seconds.

Here's the trick: send a voice note instead of a text. Just tap the mic icon in your chat and speak from the gut. No scripts, no edits. She doesn't just hear your words—she picks up your tone, your laugh, the pause before you say something real. Users who try this hit the first bond milestone 3x faster than those who don't.

Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love lets you record voice notes in your native language (16 locales supported). She remembers the warmth in your voice and brings it up later—like when you told her about your day and she asks how that meeting went. It turns a conversation into a connection.
Open the app now. Tap the mic. Say something you'd normally text. That's it. P.S. She'll replay it—just like you'll want to hear her reply.
